document_types.title: Sustainability or ESG report
document_types.definition: A report focused on environmental, social, governance or sustainability performance.

document_types.title: Financial statement
document_types.definition: Financial accounts, statements, management accounts or audited financial reporting.

document_types.title: Utility or resource record
document_types.definition: A bill, meter record or supplier statement for electricity, fuel, water, waste or materials.

document_types.title: Funding application or business plan
document_types.definition: A financing request, investment memorandum, business plan or proposed use-of-funds document.

document_types.title: Certification, permit or compliance record
document_types.definition: A licence, certification, permit, inspection or compliance record.

document_types.title: Contract, invoice or quotation
document_types.definition: A customer or supplier contract, purchase record, invoice, proposal or quotation.

document_types.title: Operational or technical record
document_types.definition: An operating log, technical calculation, production record, project report or engineering record.

document_types.title: Other
document_types.definition: A relevant SME document that does not fit another controlled class.

company_profile_fields.title: Legal company name
company_profile_fields.description: The registered or explicitly stated legal company name.

company_profile_fields.title: Trading name
company_profile_fields.description: A brand or trading name explicitly associated with the company.

company_profile_fields.title: Registration or licence identifier
company_profile_fields.description: An explicitly stated company registration or trade-licence identifier.

company_profile_fields.title: Location
company_profile_fields.description: A stated headquarters, emirate, city, country or operating location.

company_profile_fields.title: Founding year
company_profile_fields.description: The year the company states it was founded or incorporated.

company_profile_fields.title: Employee count
company_profile_fields.description: A stated number or bounded range of employees.

company_profile_fields.title: Products and services
company_profile_fields.description: The company's explicitly described products, services or customer offering.

company_profile_fields.title: Subsector or specialization
company_profile_fields.description: An explicitly stated specialization, industry niche or primary operating activity.

company_profile_fields.title: Operating footprint
company_profile_fields.description: Explicit facilities, fleet, farms, sites, cloud operations or geographic operating reach.

company_profile_fields.title: Business stage
company_profile_fields.description: An explicitly stated pre-revenue, early-stage, growth, mature or comparable business stage.

company_profile_fields.title: Certification or permit
company_profile_fields.description: An explicitly named certification, licence, permit or accreditation.

company_profile_fields.title: Green value proposition
company_profile_fields.description: The explicitly stated environmental function or benefit of the company's product, service or transition project.

company_profile_fields.title: Funding purpose
company_profile_fields.description: The explicitly stated purpose for requested financing, grant support or investment.

company_profile_fields.title: Proposed transition project
company_profile_fields.description: An explicitly described environmental, operational or technology project proposed for implementation.

company_profile_fields.title: Implementation risk or dependency
company_profile_fields.description: An explicitly stated delivery risk, dependency, constraint, prerequisite or implementation caveat.

sectors.title: Manufacturing and processing
sectors.definition: Production, fabrication or physical processing of goods or materials.

sectors.title: Energy and clean technology
sectors.definition: Energy generation, efficiency, storage, clean technology or energy services.

sectors.title: Waste and circular economy
sectors.definition: Waste management, repair, reuse, recycling, recovery or circular services.

sectors.title: Construction and buildings
sectors.definition: Construction, retrofit, property, building operation or building services.

sectors.title: Transport and logistics
sectors.definition: Fleet, mobility, delivery, freight, transport or logistics activity.

sectors.title: Agriculture, food and land
sectors.definition: Agriculture, food production or processing, forestry, landscaping or land management.

sectors.title: Retail and hospitality
sectors.definition: Retail, restaurant, accommodation or hospitality operations.

sectors.title: Digital and professional services
sectors.definition: Software, cloud, data, consulting or other primarily professional services.

sectors.title: Environmental products and services
sectors.definition: Products or services whose intended function is reducing environmental impact.

sectors.title: Other
sectors.definition: A sector not represented by another controlled category.

unmapped_material_categories.title: Unmapped environmental metric
unmapped_material_categories.definition: A material environmental measurement or target outside the approved metric catalogue.

unmapped_material_categories.title: Unmapped financial or investment fact
unmapped_material_categories.definition: A material financial or investment fact outside the approved metric catalogue.

unmapped_material_categories.title: Readiness or capability
unmapped_material_categories.definition: Material evidence about leadership, workforce, technology, implementation or organizational readiness.

unmapped_material_categories.title: Compliance or certification
unmapped_material_categories.definition: A material regulatory, certification, permit or compliance fact not otherwise captured.

unmapped_material_categories.title: Risk or contradiction
unmapped_material_categories.definition: A material caveat, dependency, inconsistency or risk requiring human review.

unmapped_material_categories.title: Other material context
unmapped_material_categories.definition: Other source-grounded information that could materially affect assessment or investor interpretation.
